title: Email: Fw: A sinking ship, built over four years

content.subject: Fw: A sinking ship, built over four years

content.text:
Anthony Fenech
Tigers beat writer
Detroit Free Press
(734) 752-9667
Twitter: @anthonyfenech
From: RICHARD KUDRAK <rkudrak21@comcast.net>
Sent: Monday, September 25, 2017 8:48 AM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: A sinking ship, built over four years 
 
    I read your article "A sinking ship, built over four years" with fascination.

You wrote "It also illuminated a reality about Martinez: for the past two seasons, according to those inside the Tigers clubhouse, the 38-year-old designated hitter, became an entitled player and a clubhouse problem whose positive influence diminished as his performance declined"..

I am stunned this negative situation was allowed to simmer for two seasons without seemingly being addressed. It shows the inability of Asmus to properly control his team, and the obvious inability of Avila to properly access his team and deal with problems.
This goes beyond some horrific free agent signings, and the multi-year struggle to put together a reliable bullpen.
